GPTR-F-001-S65.title: Error Response Contract for Enforcement Failures
GPTR-F-001-S65.description: Define standardized API error responses for allowlist and schema violations including error codes, messages, and rejection reasons to ensure deterministic handling by clients and tests.

GPTR-F-001-S66.title: Audit Logging for Allowlist Decisions
GPTR-F-001-S66.description: Implement structured audit logs capturing request metadata, enforcement decisions (pass/fail), violated rules, and caller identity for all GPTReader requests.

GPTR-F-001-S67.title: Config-Driven Allowlist Definition
GPTR-F-001-S67.description: Externalize allowlist rules (collections, fields, operators, limits) into configuration to enable controlled updates without code changes while preserving strict validation behavior.

GPTR-F-001-S68.title: SIT Scenario Integration for Scope Enforcement
GPTR-F-001-S68.description: Extend GPT SIT and integration test runners to include adversarial and boundary scenarios validating that scope enforcement blocks unauthorized queries and allows valid ones.
